pages.title: Moduli Crystal
pages.text: The extra dimensions of string theory have shapes and sizes set by fields called moduli. This crystal is those parameters frozen solid: a record of exactly how the hidden dimensions are curled. It changes shape slightly depending on the angle you view it from.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Moduli Crawlers in the Moduli Wastes of the Bulk dropped these, and more lay inside the Calabi-Yau Knot. Measuring their facets, I found they recorded the shape and size of the compact dimensions.

Made in $(item)Maxwell's Demon Sorter$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Moduli Ore$(), in veins through the Bulk.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Moduli Crawler.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Calabi Yau Knot chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Brane Cosmology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Dimensional Singularity, G₂ Manifold.
